outcome: sensorial block level of spinal anaesthesia (time to reach T4 level, maximum level)
cohort: The study included 200 patients undergoing elective cesarean sections performed under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Higher body mass index and waist/hip ratio were associated with an increased prevalence of hypotension and bradycardia, and anthropometric measurements correlated positively with sensory block characteristics during spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
cross-section timing: During elective cesarean section and spinal anesthesia application
